name: starlight-ai-harness
description: Public template: oh-my-starlight (OmS) routing brain + receipts + eval battery.
note: Exported by oms/export_template.py from the private oh-my-starlight source. Regenerate, never hand-edit this or SANITIZATION.md.
schema_note: Schema is the SoT for models, chains, caps, and package version (read version from the schema, never duplicate it here).

files.role: SoT: task classes, model chains, token pass keys, night cap, receipts/eval battery config
schema-driven chain resolution + receipt persistence (imported by route_task and gateway_call)
receipt auto-capture from OpenCode agent-loop step events
package release gate (files, schema-battery parity, selftest, route smoke, config sync)

checks: manifest file list resolves on disk
schema parses and its battery task list matches harness_eval.TASKS
harness_eval selftest (all checkers against ground truth, no model calls)
route_task classifies a smoke prompt into a class the schema actually serves
gen_omo_config output on disk contains the schema's primary model (config is in sync)
verify.rule: any check failing = package not releasable
